def min_key_presses(n, a, r1, c1, r2, c2):
    # Calculate the vertical distance
    vertical_distance = abs(r1 - r2)
    
    # Calculate the horizontal distance
    if r1 == r2:
        horizontal_distance = abs(c1 - c2)
    else:
        # Move to the end of the current line if necessary
        if c1 != a[r1 - 1] + 1:
            horizontal_distance = (a[r1 - 1] + 1 - c1) + c2
        else:
            horizontal_distance = c2
        
        # Move to the start of the target line if necessary
        if c2 != 1:
            horizontal_distance += (a[r2 - 1] + 1 - c2) + 1
        else:
            horizontal_distance += 1
    
    # Total key presses is the sum of vertical and horizontal distances
    return vertical_distance + horizontal_distance
